JUSTICE K.R. MOHAPATRA  JUSTICE SANJAY KUMAR MISHRA  ORDER 05.02.2026 Order No.
02. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
2. Petitioners in this writ petition pray for a direction to the Opposite Parties to re-determine and pay compensation for the acquired land to the Petitioners within stipulated time.

3. The Petitioners also pray for a direction to the authorities to recover the compensation wrongly paid to the Opposite Party Nos.5 & 6, in the interest of justice.
4.

Mr. Mishra, learned Counsel for the Petitioners submits that although the land in question stands recorded in the name of the Petitioners, but the compensation has been wrongly paid to the Opposite Party Nos.5 & 6.
5.

He made a representation to the Superintending Engineer (R & B), Panikoili Division, Panikoili,
Jajpur on 24.11.2025 under Annexure 13, but to no effect.
Hence, he filed this writ petition for aforesaid relief.

6. Upon hearing, learned Counsel for the Petitioners and on perusal of record, it appears that the Petitioners are aggrieved by the payment of compensation to Opposite Party Nos.5 & 6, who Puspa Rana & Ors vs Government Of Odisha & Ors. ....
